XenotypeDef.label: awakened worker drone
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Mass-produced industrial drone built by JCJenson for mining exoplanets; this awakened unit has broken free from corporate control.
XenotypeDef.description: Worker Drones are autonomous industrial machines engineered by JCJenson for exoplanet resource extraction, materials handling, and hazardous-site logistics. Built for narrow directives and strict compliance, they excel at tunneling, hauling, and precise repetitive tasks with minimal oversight. This unit has gone rogue: governance locks failed or were removed—escaped transport, abandoned after an incident, or reactivated from scrap. It now pursues its own survival and purpose, leveraging its factory-grade tools and rugged chassis. Colonies prize these units as tireless labor, though their origins often bring risk and questions.
